verdict.rationale: Asaas creates charges with a hosted payment page where the payer chooses among Pix, boleto or card, and the vendor states it sends automatic notifications before and after the due date over WhatsApp, email, SMS or voice robot. Together these cover hosted, payable invoices with automatic reminders. missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring reminder schedules and the invoice-sending/delivery flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders

citations.quote: When billingType is UNDEFINED, the payer can choose among the payment methods enabled on the account when accessing the payment page.
